opaqueProviderIdentifierMappings.policy: Language wrapper only; values remain provider-issued and the runtime performs equality checks without numeric ordering.
Language wrapper only; values remain provider-issued and the runtime performs equality checks without numeric ordering.
Java uses immutable String values and one cursor record; no additional public provider identifier API is introduced.
Kotlin reuses the Java provider contract and does not add a duplicate Kotlin wrapper surface.
TypeScript brands prevent accidental identifier mixing at compile time without adding runtime protocol fields.

decisions.subject: Service runtime placement
alternatives: shared native C runtime
one runtime per Framework language
decisions.selected: one runtime per Framework language
decisions.callerBurden: Application code uses the language's Task, coroutine, Promise and DI lifecycle without a second C lifecycle API.
decisions.informationHiding: Each runtime keeps scheduling, ownership and resource cleanup inside its language package.

decisions.subject: Handler topology context
alternatives: MeshName on every handler context
MeshName and source RID only on direct-node contexts
decisions.selected: MeshName and source RID only on direct-node contexts
decisions.callerBurden: Channel and Spot handlers do not receive transport topology data they cannot act on.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime owns ChannelName-to-topology routing.

decisions.subject: Channel target selection
alternatives: MeshName plus ChannelName
process-local unique ChannelName
decisions.selected: process-local unique ChannelName
decisions.callerBurden: A caller selects a logical target with one name.
decisions.informationHiding: Physical RouteMesh or ClientServer lookup stays inside the runtime.

decisions.subject: Actor transfer timing
alternatives: Actor-specific transfer timeout plus forwarding window
forwarding window plus host deadline
decisions.selected: forwarding window plus host deadline
decisions.callerBurden: The application does not coordinate two overlapping transfer deadlines.
decisions.informationHiding: The host operation owns the terminal time bound.

decisions.subject: Channel role builder
alternatives: shared settings before role selection
Client and Server role-specific builders
decisions.selected: Client and Server role-specific builders
decisions.callerBurden: A Client cannot be configured with Server-only weight or handlers.
decisions.informationHiding: Invalid role states cannot be represented.

decisions.subject: Location owner authority
alternatives: provider methods for every phase
opaque expected-version CAS
decisions.selected: opaque expected-version CAS
decisions.callerBurden: Store providers implement one concurrency primitive instead of the Framework state machine.
decisions.informationHiding: Transfer phases remain owned by the Framework runtime.

decisions.subject: Transfer policy ownership
alternatives: separate adapter registry
typed policy attached to the factory
decisions.selected: typed policy attached to the factory
decisions.callerBurden: Type creation and state policy are configured in one place.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime does not expose a second transfer registry.

decisions.subject: Transfer initiation
alternatives: one public operation per object
host Retire operation
decisions.selected: host Retire operation
decisions.callerBurden: Applications do not assemble target, phase and retry order.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime owns the distributed transfer state machine.

decisions.subject: Host termination
alternatives: extend Drain with policy variants
Retire and Shutdown
decisions.selected: Retire and Shutdown
decisions.callerBurden: The caller chooses continuity or bounded termination without configuring hidden relocation behavior.
decisions.informationHiding: Object cleanup and force-stop sequencing remain internal.

decisions.subject: One-way submission
alternatives: TrySubmit plus asynchronous submit
asynchronous submit only
decisions.selected: asynchronous submit only
decisions.callerBurden: Cold resolve and bounded admission do not create a second public call state.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime owns lookup and admission waiting.

decisions.subject: Remote maintenance endpoint
alternatives: fixed Framework HTTP route
hosting or application endpoint
decisions.selected: hosting or application endpoint
decisions.callerBurden: Authentication and deployment targeting use the application's existing hosting policy.
decisions.informationHiding: The Framework does not publish a second unaffiliated control endpoint.

decisions.subject: Transfer data
alternatives: Checkpoint Store for every transfer byte
peer staging plus durable Checkpoint Store
decisions.selected: peer staging plus durable Checkpoint Store
decisions.callerBurden: Applications provide typed state without choosing transport and recovery storage per operation.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime owns staging, replay cursor and duplicate removal.

decisions.subject: Core raw contract documentation
alternatives: duplicate Core raw contract in the v11 target
Core formal spec as the only raw contract
decisions.selected: Core formal spec as the only raw contract
decisions.callerBurden: Binding authors have one raw contract to inspect.
decisions.informationHiding: The v11 plan records migration ownership without creating a second raw API source.

decisions.subject: Transport liveness responsibility
alternatives: retain Core ZMP heartbeat and its public socket options
remove ZMP heartbeat and implement topology-specific internal Framework liveness
decisions.selected: remove ZMP heartbeat and implement topology-specific internal Framework liveness
decisions.callerBurden: Applications do not configure probe values or treat unrelated inbound traffic as service health.
decisions.informationHiding: Each current connection admits Ready, keeps at most one outstanding periodic probe and refreshes only on its matching ACK.

decisions.subject: Fanout publisher failure attribution
alternatives: share one SUB socket and expose publisher identity in application or wire metadata
use one internal SUB socket per publisher endpoint
decisions.selected: use one internal SUB socket per publisher endpoint
decisions.callerBurden: Application events and handler metadata do not carry transport publisher identity.
decisions.informationHiding: The fanout runtime attributes timeout and reconnect state to the owning socket without adding a public routing field.

decisions.subject: Spot lifecycle capability split
alternatives: one eight-callback lifecycle interface for every Spot kind
base lifecycle plus Actor capability, Entry-only create capability and actor-free Instance interface
decisions.selected: base lifecycle plus Actor capability, Entry-only create capability and actor-free Instance interface
decisions.callerBurden: Each Spot kind implements only callbacks that can occur for that kind; Instance Spot exposes Configure, Initialize and Closing only.
decisions.informationHiding: Actor membership and Entry creation stay in opt-in capabilities instead of leaking into every factory type.

decisions.subject: Instance activation control surface
alternatives: public or Core C target, token and begin-commit-close activation lifecycle
InstanceSpotAddress messaging plus factory registration with internal claim, fencing and barrier state
decisions.selected: InstanceSpotAddress messaging plus factory registration with internal claim, fencing and barrier state
decisions.callerBurden: Applications submit by logical address and register a factory without sequencing claim or activation phases.
decisions.informationHiding: Owner ID, generation, epoch and native activation token remain private to each Framework runtime.

decisions.subject: Actor reference identity
alternatives: include Actor type in every reference and snapshot
use node RID, Actor ID and generation only
decisions.selected: use node RID, Actor ID and generation only
decisions.callerBurden: Callers preserve one canonical reference shape across languages and do not supply type metadata when restoring a snapshot.
decisions.informationHiding: Actor type validation stays with the registered factory and authority record.

decisions.subject: Spot resolver identity
alternatives: infer the process-local mesh from a RID or Actor ID
require MeshName with the logical identifier
decisions.selected: require MeshName with the logical identifier
decisions.callerBurden: A resolver call identifies the same logical key in every host and language.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime selects the current node and physical route after resolving the mesh-scoped key.

decisions.subject: C++ runtime extension surface
alternatives: publish registries, invokers, serializer state and raw physical routes
publish typed configuration and call facades with private runtime wiring
decisions.selected: publish typed configuration and call facades with private runtime wiring
decisions.callerBurden: Applications register typed handlers and submit logical calls without constructing dispatch or codec state.
decisions.informationHiding: DI resolution, serializer selection, raw routing and invocation tables remain inside the C++ runtime.

decisions.subject: Actor placement ownership
alternatives: accept caller-provided node and route hints
select an arbitrary remote target from capacity
create on the current host's MeshName-selected local MeshNode
decisions.selected: create on the current host's MeshName-selected local MeshNode
decisions.callerBurden: Actor creation supplies MeshName, Actor ID and Actor type without node RID or route hints.
decisions.informationHiding: Create and get-or-create never start distributed placement or hidden remote creation.

decisions.subject: C++ Spot lifecycle typing
alternatives: detect lifecycle methods by duck typing
use Actor-typed virtual base classes with constrained registration
decisions.selected: use Actor-typed virtual base classes with constrained registration
decisions.callerBurden: A Spot implementation gets compile-time errors for missing or invalid lifecycle callbacks.
decisions.informationHiding: Factory registration does not infer roles from names, files or runtime method tables.

decisions.subject: Instance Spot registration capability
alternatives: share the Actor-capable registry and reject invalid registrations at activation
provide a packet-only Instance registry
decisions.selected: provide a packet-only Instance registry
decisions.callerBurden: Instance code cannot request Actor or subscription capabilities that the runtime will reject.
decisions.informationHiding: Actor membership and Logical Multicast registration never enter the Instance activation path.

decisions.subject: Actor membership fencing
alternatives: expose a callback-specific membership counter
use provider ownerGeneration for membership writes and objectGeneration for route identity
decisions.selected: use provider ownerGeneration for membership writes and objectGeneration for route identity
decisions.callerBurden: Lifecycle callbacks receive Actor identity without coordinating an extra counter.
decisions.informationHiding: Expected StoreVersion, ownerGeneration checks and CAS retry policy remain runtime state.

decisions.subject: Host lifecycle owner lease
alternatives: one lease per descriptor and routing slot
one process-lifecycle owner token shared by descriptors, authorities and routing slots
decisions.selected: one process-lifecycle owner token shared by descriptors, authorities and routing slots
decisions.callerBurden: Applications do not create, reuse or coordinate owner IDs across registrations.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime owns the six common duration values, validates renew interval plus timeout below TTL minus OwnerLeaseFencingMargin for every owner-lease host, and keeps routing slots on the same deadline.

decisions.subject: Checkpoint retention after authority commit
alternatives: permanently promote a reference after CAS
store without TTL and enumerate orphan checkpoints
renew a fixed 24-hour provider lease while the authority reference is current
decisions.selected: renew a fixed 24-hour provider lease while the authority reference is current
decisions.callerBurden: Applications do not configure retention or run an orphan reaper.
decisions.informationHiding: The owner or recovery coordinator renews only the current reference; missing renewal is a closed provider result.

decisions.subject: Actor location source of truth
alternatives: maintain a typed Actor location row beside transfer authority
store owner location and transfer state in one opaque authority row
decisions.selected: store owner location and transfer state in one opaque authority row
decisions.callerBurden: Actor directory and Spot-handle resolution use one logical identity without reconciling two records.
decisions.informationHiding: Providers expose generic paged authority enumeration; the Framework decodes operational list projections and never uses them as routing authority.

decisions.subject: Placement capability description
alternatives: publish independent type, state-contract and capacity collections
publish one object-kind and type keyed capability record
decisions.selected: publish one object-kind and type keyed capability record
decisions.callerBurden: Target eligibility is read from one record instead of constructing invalid cross-products.
decisions.informationHiding: Policy, readable state contracts and capacity stay bound to the factory capability that owns them.

decisions.subject: Authority generation allocation
alternatives: derive per-key counters and retain permanent tombstones
use provider-domain global objectGeneration, authorityOwnerGeneration and storeRevision counters
decisions.selected: use provider-domain global objectGeneration, authorityOwnerGeneration and storeRevision counters
decisions.callerBurden: Framework runtimes select preserve, new-owner or new-object without inventing counters or coordinating a second write.
decisions.informationHiding: Delete removes the row; only active snapshot scans may retain bounded temporary deletion metadata.

decisions.subject: Actor lookup and creation surface
alternatives: let ActorDirectory ensure an Actor without a type
keep ActorDirectory read-only and require Actor type on local ActorManager creation
decisions.selected: keep ActorDirectory read-only and require Actor type on local ActorManager creation
decisions.callerBurden: A caller uses one existing-only logical lookup and supplies type only when it explicitly creates an Actor.
decisions.informationHiding: Actor type is fixed in authority after factory selection and is not duplicated in ActorRef or directory identity.

decisions.subject: Actor membership leave initiator
alternatives: let Actor context mutate its own membership
let the owning Spot context remove its typed Actor
decisions.selected: let the owning Spot context remove its typed Actor
decisions.callerBurden: Spot code initiates membership changes through the same owner that serializes membership callbacks.
decisions.informationHiding: Actor context does not gain a second registration or membership authority surface.

decisions.subject: Cross-language ordinal range
alternatives: expose the full unsigned 64-bit range and define JVM bit reinterpretation
use the common positive signed 64-bit range
decisions.selected: use the common positive signed 64-bit range
decisions.callerBurden: Every language compares object, authority-owner and lease generation, revision and sequence as a non-negative public value.
decisions.informationHiding: Providers and runtimes stop at exhaustion instead of leaking wrap or language-specific reinterpretation.

decisions.subject: Spot kind and owner authority
alternatives: separate User and Instance Spot rows
one authority key for MeshName and SpotRid
decisions.selected: one authority key for MeshName and SpotRid
decisions.callerBurden: Callers use one Spot identity and receive an atomic kind conflict instead of reconciling two stores.
decisions.informationHiding: The provider CAS allocates objectGeneration while the runtime validates Spot kind and type.

decisions.subject: Authority durability
alternatives: expire authority with the owner lease
keep authority durable until explicit fenced delete
decisions.selected: keep authority durable until explicit fenced delete
decisions.callerBurden: Recovery does not depend on refreshing an application-visible authority TTL.
decisions.informationHiding: Owner and coordinator leases remain separate token rows and cannot mutate authority on expiry.

decisions.subject: Authority recovery enumeration
alternatives: public scan ID, watermark and cursor tuple
one provider-issued opaque scan cursor
decisions.selected: one provider-issued opaque scan cursor
decisions.callerBurden: The runtime passes one immutable continuation value unchanged and cannot combine invalid scan positions.
decisions.informationHiding: The provider keeps all snapshot state behind a non-empty cursor bounded to 4096 encoded bytes; the runtime discards partial results on ScanExpired and exact-reads every candidate before CAS.

decisions.subject: Complete message size bound
alternatives: fixed 16 MiB or live mutable local limit
startup-normalized peer-negotiated effective bound
decisions.selected: startup-normalized peer-negotiated effective bound
decisions.callerBurden: A caller configures one startup value and does not synchronize live peer limits.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime exchanges normalized bounds internally and enforces the minimum before allocation.

decisions.subject: Large checkpoint representation
alternatives: expose chunk controls or reduce normal message size
fixed internal 64 MiB chunks and root manifest
decisions.selected: fixed internal 64 MiB chunks and root manifest
decisions.callerBurden: Checkpoint Store providers keep one opaque put and get surface without format options.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime enforces 4096 chunks and a 256 GiB logical ceiling with reversible seal rollback.

decisions.subject: Routing slot lease ownership
alternatives: issue a second slot lease
atomically validate the existing host owner token
decisions.selected: atomically validate the existing host owner token
decisions.callerBurden: A host does not renew two lease systems for the same lifecycle.
decisions.informationHiding: The provider keeps the bounded coherent group snapshot and validates slot 1..65535 and members 1..255.

decisions.subject: Session Actor relay reply capability
alternatives: infer a current request from Actor state
transfer an explicit dispatch context
decisions.selected: transfer an explicit dispatch context
decisions.callerBurden: Actor code relays one typed request without constructing correlation or retry state.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime owns terminal-once reply correlation and admission failure mapping.

decisions.subject: Transfer state JSON compatibility
alternatives: byte-canonical application JSON or message-specific codec registration
frameworkJsonV1 semantic profile keyed by stateContractId
decisions.selected: frameworkJsonV1 semantic profile keyed by stateContractId
decisions.callerBurden: Adapters exchange typed state without registering per-message codecs or reproducing canonical bytes.
decisions.informationHiding: Only internal manifest, chunk and envelope bytes are canonical; application checkpoint bytes stay opaque.

decisions.subject: Transfer completion admission barrier
alternatives: open the target at Activated
keep ingress sealed through source cleanup and Completed CAS
decisions.selected: keep ingress sealed through source cleanup and Completed CAS
decisions.callerBurden: Applications do not coordinate phase gates or defend against two active owners.
decisions.informationHiding: Restore, replay and bound-session routes remain staged until the runtime opens Ready ingress.

decisions.subject: Owner lease lookup and cleanup
alternatives: publish an unbounded lease snapshot and owner-ID-only cleanup
exact read and token-fenced bulk cleanup
decisions.selected: exact read and token-fenced bulk cleanup
decisions.callerBurden: Providers implement one bounded identity lookup and cannot delete a newer owner's records.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime retains the exact owner token through admission and cleanup.

decisions.subject: Descriptor reconciliation
alternatives: unbounded provider lists or partial page updates
bounded pages assembled under a stable scope change stamp
decisions.selected: bounded pages assembled under a stable scope change stamp
decisions.callerBurden: Applications do not merge pages or observe half-applied topology snapshots.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime retries when before and after stamps differ and providers own opaque continuation tokens.

decisions.subject: Authority hot-row resource budget
alternatives: store terminal replies in unbounded authority payloads
bound payload and pages while streaming reply bytes through checkpoints
decisions.selected: bound payload and pages while streaming reply bytes through checkpoints
decisions.callerBurden: Providers implement fixed 1 MiB row and 4 MiB page budgets without public byte tuning.
decisions.informationHiding: Hot rows contain compact metadata and replay cursors while complete terminal replies remain checkpoint data.

decisions.subject: Admitted descriptor mutation
alternatives: accept every field update after admission
freeze identity fields and fence mutable fields by revision
decisions.selected: freeze identity fields and fence mutable fields by revision
decisions.callerBurden: Operators update declared runtime state without reconstructing identity or resolving mixed revisions.
decisions.informationHiding: The provider rejects stale or identity-changing updates before they alter discovery state.

decisions.subject: Transferred terminal reply acknowledgement
alternatives: expose reply acknowledgement to Actor code
use one internal replyRelayAck barrier
decisions.selected: use one internal replyRelayAck barrier
decisions.callerBurden: Application handlers complete a reply once without coordinating relay durability.
decisions.informationHiding: Internal command 46 carries only transferId, operationId, the exact request-source owner and node fence, and status; ACK or stored source-lease expiry, never connection close, supplies terminal accounting.

decisions.subject: Instance cold activation claim
alternatives: let the target claim after outbound
resolve and claim ColdActivating at the source before outbound
decisions.selected: resolve and claim ColdActivating at the source before outbound
decisions.callerBurden: One send deadline covers target selection, claim and source outbound admission.
decisions.informationHiding: The target only revalidates the token and generation, activates and commits Ready.

decisions.subject: Derived descriptor registration budget
alternatives: truncate or split oversized registration
validate the fully derived descriptor atomically at startup
decisions.selected: validate the fully derived descriptor atomically at startup
decisions.callerBurden: Configuration fails before bind instead of publishing an incomplete capability view.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime enforces 1 MiB encoded, 1024 capability and 1024 readable-contract bounds without partial publish.

decisions.subject: Transfer session and target reservations
alternatives: reuse host lease as every transient reservation
keep internal token-fenced session-owner and target-reservation leases
decisions.selected: keep internal token-fenced session-owner and target-reservation leases
decisions.callerBurden: Applications do not renew or order transient transfer reservations.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime binds both internal leases to current owner and authority generations and releases them at terminal barriers.

decisions.subject: MeshNode auto-connect resolver surface
alternatives: publish a .NET-only unbounded live-node resolver
keep auto-connect resolution internal and use the bounded provider page contract
decisions.selected: keep auto-connect resolution internal and use the bounded provider page contract
decisions.callerBurden: All languages expose the same operational query surface instead of one parity exception.
decisions.informationHiding: Stable-stamp page assembly remains inside the runtime auto-connect reconciler.

decisions.subject: Maintenance callback retry semantics
alternatives: promise exactly-once factory capture and restore
define attempt-level at-least-once callbacks under an exact current fence
decisions.selected: define attempt-level at-least-once callbacks under an exact current fence
decisions.callerBurden: Application capture and restoration are retry-safe and do not depend on an exposed transfer ID.
decisions.informationHiding: Only the current owner and attempt may commit completion or open admission; stale callbacks may overlap but cannot commit.

decisions.subject: Location Store failure grace
alternatives: extend owner authority deadlines during Store failure
freeze only the last stable discovery desired set for new-connect reconciliation
decisions.selected: freeze only the last stable discovery desired set for new-connect reconciliation
decisions.callerBurden: Existing transport follows service liveness while new connections wait for a stable recovered snapshot.
decisions.informationHiding: Stateful admission still closes at the last valid monotonic lease deadline; recovery revalidates owner token and full page set before diff and connect.

decisions.subject: Deprecated C++ drain result mapping
alternatives: retain non-isomorphic legacy failure reasons
map every allowed Shutdown terminal reason one-to-one
decisions.selected: map every allowed Shutdown terminal reason one-to-one
decisions.callerBurden: A legacy drain caller receives one closed reason that preserves the Shutdown terminal cause without guessing.
decisions.informationHiding: The facade delegates to the shared Shutdown operation and does not recreate obsolete publish or owner-cleanup phases.

decisions.subject: Asynchronous provider storage and cancellation
alternatives: let callers infer buffer retention and cancellation commit semantics
fix storage lifetime and reconcile unknown completion inside the runtime
decisions.selected: fix storage lifetime and reconcile unknown completion inside the runtime
decisions.callerBurden: Providers receive one completion-bounded input lifetime and never expose an ambiguous commit result to applications.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime snapshots mutable boundaries, reconciles CAS and content-addressed puts, and cleans unlinked commits by retention.

decisions.subject: Monotonic generation exhaustion
alternatives: wrap or reuse exhausted generation values
return a closed non-retriable result without mutation
decisions.selected: return a closed non-retriable result without mutation
decisions.callerBurden: A provider reports exhaustion without requiring applications to distinguish counter implementation details.
decisions.informationHiding: Authority CAS and owner lease claim own separate closed exhaustion results; routing allocation remains distinct.

decisions.subject: Opaque lifecycle source and storeless Actor boundary
alternatives: expose ordered lifecycle counters and caller-selected sources
keep equality tokens and source selection inside the runtime
decisions.selected: keep equality tokens and source selection inside the runtime
decisions.callerBurden: Callers compare no lifecycle numbers and cannot accidentally use a storeless Actor as a distributed object.
decisions.informationHiding: Store-backed fences, manual nonces and process-local authority share no new public union or option.

decisions.subject: Pre-Captured drain and transferable membership
alternatives: capture incomplete connection-bound work or User Spot membership
drain terminal work and require source Entry membership before capture
decisions.selected: drain terminal work and require source Entry membership before capture
decisions.callerBurden: Retire returns the existing blocked result before changing authority when continuity cannot be proven.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime owns journal eligibility, atomic NewOwner membership replacement and durable cleanup ordering.

decisions.subject: Object creation publication barrier
alternatives: publish objects while factory or initialization is incomplete
publish Ready only after fenced construction and initialization
decisions.selected: publish Ready only after fenced construction and initialization
decisions.callerBurden: Resolvers observe either a complete object or the existing typed failure without hidden retries.
decisions.informationHiding: Creating, ColdActivating and fenced delete reconciliation remain internal state.

decisions.subject: User Spot close with active membership
alternatives: implicitly move or destroy Actor members during close
return false without changing Spot or Actor state
decisions.selected: return false without changing Spot or Actor state
decisions.callerBurden: The caller uses the existing boolean and explicitly resolves Actor membership before retrying close.
decisions.informationHiding: The runtime does not expose an additional InUse result or hidden membership operation.

decisions.subject: Retire deadline phase semantics
alternatives: collapse every deadline into forced termination
distinguish pre-seal blocked timeout from post-seal forced timeout
decisions.selected: distinguish pre-seal blocked timeout from post-seal forced timeout
decisions.callerBurden: The existing outcome and reason pair tells operators whether admission changed.
decisions.informationHiding: Preflight and teardown remain internal phases and require no new enum values.
